name: orchestration
description: Splits work across Claude models. Ships three read-only Haiku subagents (repo-map and call-sites query a local codebase-memory code graph and check it against the source, api-docs fetches library documentation), a delegate skill that tells the main session when to use them, a setup skill that configures the main model, the Opus advisor, Flightdeck, permissions and the CLAUDE.md rules, and hooks: a code-graph refresh, a Sonnet gate on six risky Bash command families and a Stop check for missing test reports and breaches of the global CLAUDE.md writing rules. The gates are second opinions that fail open on timeout.
